question: What is the course registration deadline?
answer: The course registration deadline is Monday 23 November 2026 [announcements-current-files]. From this date, a penalty of 10,000 FCFA applies to any student who registers for courses after the deadline [procedures-course-registration]. Students must present valid, signed and stamped registration forms to their lecturers by 16 November 2026 to be included in the official class list [announcements-current-files].
